projectContent.text:
Created for Jerusalem Design Week 2024 – "Buy Bye" – For Good and Bad Times
Whether you’re celebrating life’s highs or preparing for the lows, Buy Bye has got you covered. This quirky pop-up shop is packed with rebranded essentials, all with a satirical twist to lay bare the Israeli reality.

We’ve created a fictitious supermarket that blends humor with reality, offering everything you might need for both joyful celebrations and unexpected disasters. It’s not just a store—it’s a space where satire meets survival.
